title: The New Trading For A Living

questions.q: What rule limits risk to 2% of total capital per trade?
questions.why: Elder's 2% rule caps risk at 2% of capital.

questions.q: Why can commissions erode profits for new traders?
a: They are a fixed cost per trade
questions.why: A $10 commission per trade reduces returns when capital is small.

questions.q: What does Elder advise about emotions in trading?
questions.why: He compares emotional trading to gambling.

questions.q: How does the 6% rule differ from the 2% rule?
a: It limits loss on a losing streak
It sets a maximum position size
questions.why: The 6% rule helps avoid large cumulative losses.

questions.why: His psychiatry background influenced his psychological focus.
